notes.title: Bocobo level skip! Bug fixes!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 

Added a new feature to the Adventure Camp. If you have cleared a floor a Bocobo feather will now spawn next to the fire. You can use this to skip floors and get back to your adventure. You will spawn next to a paragon crystal and be given 50% of the average soul fragments you would have gotten if you played through the previous floor!

Note: Floor skip is ONLY for "Normal" mode. Hard mode is hard for a reason!

Also, Some bug fixes and spelling errors have been squashed.

Thank you all for playing, please don't forget to leave a review and let me know what you would like to see added, changed, or think is extremely unfair... :P

notes.title: "A New Path" Bug fixes 1.0
notes.content:
Some bug fixes!

Bosses can no longer be mugged ( would cause a crash )

Escape can also be used to open inventory on keyboard controls
( Tab is now used for quick restarts )

Lowered default SFX to 30%

notes.title: A New Path Released!!!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32071487/dc6339d2a095e2c003c8ebe64bcf4c7ab0ae06bd.png[/img]

Welp, It's finally here. After months of hard work the new patch is finally done cooking. I truly hope you all enjoy the new content! Please tell all your friends and remember to rate the game! Every little bit helps! I would love to do a new contest for "Hard Mode" and see which of you are crazy enough to take the challenge :)

Patch Notes:

Paragon Talent System 

Achievements ( can also unlock new talent trees )

New Paragons

New Items

Hard Mode ( ...this is VERY action packed and difficult )

Please let me know if you notice any bugs! When i wake up from my minor coma I will make sure to fix anything you guys find. 

Have fun!

notes.title: Contest has a winner!
notes.content:
The "First to beat the game!" Contest has officially ended and we have a winner! It was an epic battle and I enjoyed watching the entire play through!

I will announce the winner and more info on the next patch once we finalize the details!  ( He's getting a paragon! )

Thanks to everyone that participated in the event and I hope I can hold more fun contests in the future!

notes.title: End of contest announcement and "A New Path" delayed!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

So some quick things, I will be ending the "First to beat the game" contest on May 20th at 11:59 pm est. The new content patch will help players beat the game and with time it will become easier, especially when you understand the new talent system. So if you were trying for the $200 steam gift card! You have 9 days left!

A New Path has been delayed! I am sure if I crammed in all the work as soon as possible it would be ready by the 15th but I have come across some..balancing issues and would like to iron them out while finishing the new content. So I will be delaying the patch for a bit. Once it is ready i will launch it without delay!

I hope everyone has been enjoying themselves, thank you again for enjoying this project. It brings me great pleasure knowing there are people that enjoy my game. 

Enjoy your weekend and don't forget! Sunday is Mother's Day!

notes.title: May 1st still alive notice!
notes.content:
Hello to everyone! Here with a little update about the new patch coming to SBA!

I hope everyone is enjoying the game! The next content update will be named "A New Path" and includes new ways to advance and finally complete the game.

A new talent system using soul fragments and achievements will be part of this update! Including new paragons and many more things.

I am shooting for the update to hit by May 15th. I will let everyone know if that date will be delayed, but it looks pretty good for now :3

ALSO! The $200 steam cash contest is STILL going. No one has beaten the game yet. Remember if you are trying to win the steam money you must record the video to provide proof!

Debating if the contest will end with the release of "A New Path" as the talent system and other things coming to the game will help players significantly. 

Take care and thanks for reading!

notes.title: Patch before the storm!
notes.content:
I've decided to throw in the bug fixes now before the content patch because it REALLY helps the game play much better, players that had performance issues should see a HUGE improvement!

Patch Notes:

- Projectiles go "over" walls again

- All levels on floors 3 - 5 now obey BGM volume setting

- Fixed some holes in a few walls :3

- Enemies will no longer get stuck on walls

- Dashing near walls no longer slows your dash speed

- Charging near walls no longer tractor beams you up to the wall

- Redesigned lighting system to use much less resources

That's it for now! I will have more information on the content patch and some video coming soon. Enjoy!

notes.title: Large patch on the horizon!
notes.content:
I wanted to say a big thank you to everyone that has purchased the game! The feedback I have gotten from you all has been a great help and there is much more to come! Thank you, for all of your support. 

Currently there is a large patch in development that will resolve bugs and add new content to the game! I hope everyone is looking forward to new powers, paragons, ways to progress, items and achievements!

Also! The $200 Steam gift card challenge is STILL GOING! No one has claimed victory yet, tell your friends, share your knowledge and earn that reward!

Good luck! :3

notes.title: Super Bit Adventure $200 Steam Gift Card Challenge!
notes.content:
Announcing the Super Bit Adventure: Paragons of Life "Can you beat it?" Challenge!
I made this game because i enjoy a good challenge. I am searching for others that enjoy that kind of difficulty as well!
Rules are simple. Beat the game while recording your adventure, then upload it to Youtube and shoot me an email! 
This will ensure that no bugs, exploits, or hacks were used to complete the challenge.

The first person to complete the game legitimately and email me the link to the evidence will be awarded a $200 Steam Gift Card!

The email is here > sba.pol.contest@gmail.com

The game is here > http://store.steampowered.com/app/778640/Super_Bit_Adventure_Paragons_of_Life/

The twitter ( I don't use it much but I will announce when a winner as been found ) > https://twitter.com/ZiomatrixX

My prayers and thoughts for your fingers are here > *nothing here* XD

Good luck and have fun!
